searchText: This used to be my neighborhood grocery store. It still is my brother's. When asked how many were killed all the police will say is "We are still processing the crime scene." District Attorney says family are being notified first, and there will be more information with 2 or 3 hours. My brother and his family are fine, not sure about all of our friends. https://www.9news.com/article/news/crime/shooting-boulder-king-soopers-table-mesa/73-f5825a61-8b9b-4b5a-a550-36edf1c44d50 Local videographer happened to be entering store as shooting was unfolding. There were three bodies on the ground. Police reported only person in hospital - the suspect. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ikujTMetrUk&feature=youtu.be This is wildly off topic... Not for me it isn't. And some of my best friends are here. (I did just remove garish embeds.) So sorry to see that I hope there ok. Thanks, <@!636289909359116290>. They just confirmed 10 dead. Puts my troubles here in perspective. I’m so sorry to hear that. Indeed so many awful things happen in the world and all we can do is just remember them and move forward with our lives as we work to improve it. <@683653554631868440> I’m glad to hear your family is ok and I hope you treasure your moments with them. While it is terrible that this happened in a story with an association with you, it's unclear how you are directly affected. Unfortunately many people die every day in the US, and many more around the world. It seems like if you put this in <#595721451651465227> you would get more direct sympathy and more condolences. <@!687535760965894191> For all I knew my brother was in that store. We still don't whether there are friends among the dead. I'm directly affected. I wasn't seeking condolences. My emotional state is indeed fragile right now. Forgive my intrusion. EthereumJS Berlin HF releases are now out, most notably are a Berlin-ready VM and the Transaction library now supporting EIP-2930 Typed Transactions: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/releases Nice! To be clear, this means EthereumJS can _accept_ 2930 transactions, but not generate access lists, correct? <@!552133098075193354> yes, that's correct! We have an issue for this open though https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/issues/1152 , we can prioritize if wished, this might be useful for web tools, eventually also MetaMask (I guess I'll just directly reach out and ask). Update: respectively I guess we'll prioritize anyhow, this is not a dramatic amount of work and I guess this *will* be useful in some contexts. Yeah, I think it would be super helpful to have tools we can point the community to that help easily generate acecss lists Respectively I am just realizing that it's relatively easy for us to have our VM generate access lists on *some* state - there the prerequisites are more or less there - it's a bit different to operate on the real mainnet state though. So we can provide this as a dev tool, for the use case to actually send or prepare mainnet txs (e.g. for MetaMask) I am not sure atm. Think we need to give this some more thought. (so I'll take a bit a step back, don't want to overpromise here) Got it 👍 warning! there is an active scammer impersonating me on discord. I put it in annoucements but want to make extra sure you see it as I am still getting notifications they are at large <@!291925846556540928> Yes, he contacted me. He "needs a favor" don't we all..
